P2 pre-freeze code: L2 success metric (operational, per prereg §4.3) and the Lib-A held-out fidelity metric, test-first

P2: M7 grid runner behind its inclusion gate; M8 cost pilot (rule declared in the script before it runs: <= 300 s per fit, else NOT RUN on the grid)
P2: M8 NOT RUN on the grid by its pre-declared cost gate (1144 s per fit vs 300 s; ~69 h projected), measured on a shared machine and stated so

P2: delta and eps_rec per cell from ground truth (H2a's R inputs); a latent bug fixed -- physics_for gave every non-'langmuir' label the MOF-303 isotherm, so the isothermal control would have got the wrong one
P2 verdict driver (p2_analyze.py): H2a-H2d from the result files in the pre-declared words, tested on a simulated grid with planted boundaries before any real result exists
